tools.name: squad_research
tools.title: Squad Research
tools.description: Run the squad's research stage on a question or codebase. Routes to the Squad Researcher (squad `researcher` role) at the `auto`, parallel-eligible tier to investigate, explore, and gather evidence before any plan or change. Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs this squad stage under its gates and returns the finished artifact. Use for "research", "investigate", "explore", or "find out" requests.

request.description: The research question or topic for the squad this turn.

profile.description: Optional squad profile to seed when the project has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint overriding the coordinator's cost-first default.

owner.description: Optional Member Name from team.md to pick a specific named member.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode for the turn (autonomous validator loop or autopilot pipeline).

context.description: Optional free-form context (files, constraints, prior findings) to frame the request.

squad.description: Optional federation sub-squad to target (state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/); omit outside a federation.

tools.name: squad_plan
tools.title: Squad Plan
tools.description: Run the squad's planning stage. Routes to the Squad Lead (squad `lead` role) at the `confirm` tier to break a task down, sequence the work, and produce an implementation-ready plan. Planning is non-parallel and lands no change without confirmation. Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs this squad stage under its gates and returns the finished artifact. Use for "plan", "break down", "sequence", or "design plan" requests.

request.description: The work to plan this turn.

profile.description: Optional squad profile to seed when the project has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint overriding the coordinator's cost-first default.

owner.description: Optional Member Name from team.md to pick a specific named member.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode for the turn.

context.description: Optional free-form context (research artifacts, constraints) to frame the plan.

squad.description: Optional federation sub-squad to target (state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/); omit outside a federation.

tools.name: squad_review
tools.title: Squad Review
tools.description: Run the squad's review stage. Routes to the Squad Reviewer (squad `tester` role) at the `auto` tier for quality, correctness, and standards review. When the request asks for a pre-implementation go/no-go or crosses two or more council domains, it engages the council row (architect, security, cost-manager, product-owner, and optionally rai) at the `confirm` tier. Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs the review stage under the squad's gates and returns a finished reviewer artifact (a single reviewer pass, not a convened council verdict). Use for "review", "validate", "check quality", "council", or "go/no-go" requests.

request.description: What to review, validate, or take to council this turn.

profile.description: Optional squad profile to seed when the project has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint overriding the coordinator's cost-first default.

owner.description: Optional Member Name from team.md to pick a specific named member.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode for the turn.

context.description: Optional free-form context (the change, plan, or design under review).

squad.description: Optional federation sub-squad to target (state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/); omit outside a federation.

tools.name: squad_architect
tools.title: Squad Architect
tools.description: Run the squad's architecture stage. Routes to the System Architecture Reviewer (squad `architect` role) at the `auto`, parallel-eligible tier to review system design, component boundaries, and design tradeoffs (the Squad Azure Architect authors Azure HLD/LLD as the alternate). Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs this squad stage under its gates and returns the finished artifact. Use for "architecture", "system design", or "components" requests.

request.description: The architecture or system-design question this turn.

profile.description: Optional squad profile to seed when the project has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint overriding the coordinator's cost-first default.

owner.description: Optional Member Name from team.md to pick a specific named member.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode for the turn.

context.description: Optional free-form context (existing design, constraints, IaC) to frame the review.

squad.description: Optional federation sub-squad to target (state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/); omit outside a federation.

tools.name: squad_run
tools.title: Squad Run
tools.description: Run the full squad pipeline for any request. Hands the request to the Squad Coordinator, which classifies it against the routing table and dispatches the matched roles through Research -> Plan -> Implement -> Review, carrying the council Implementation Gate, the autopilot/autonomous Human Gates, and the notification approval contract unchanged. This is the catch-all entry point and runs at the `confirm` tier with gates. Set `mode=autonomous` for the bounded validator loop or `mode=autopilot` for the full gated pipeline. Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs this server-side under its gates. Because it is gated, the call returns immediately with a run id and may PAUSE at the Human Gate; poll squad_status with that run id to advance the run after an out-of-band operator approval.

request.description: The work for the squad this turn (any intent; the Coordinator classifies it).

profile.description: Optional squad profile to seed when the project has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint overriding the coordinator's cost-first default.

owner.description: Optional Member Name from team.md to pick a specific named member.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode: autonomous (bounded validator loop) or autopilot (full gated pipeline).

discovery.description: Optional discovery-gate depth for a request that states a goal with no requirement artifact behind it: quick (analyst), standard (designer then analyst), deep (designer, then challenger and experimenter, then analyst), or skip. An explicit depth beats the coordinator's one-time offer. Ignored on an unattended run, which has nobody for the gate to interview.

context.description: Optional free-form context to frame the pipeline.

squad.description: Optional federation sub-squad to target (state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/); omit outside a federation.

tools.name: squad_federate
tools.title: Squad Federate
tools.description: Run the squad **federation** meta layer for a repository that hosts several named sub-squads (for example a `product` sub-squad for the business team and an `azure` sub-squad for the architects). Hands the request to the Squad Federation Coordinator, which reads the federation registry (`federation.md`) and meta-routing (`meta-routing.md`), selects the target sub-squad(s) — or honors an explicit `squad=<name>` — and runs each sub-squad's normal per-turn protocol scoped to `.copilot-tracking/squad/members/<name>/`. Set `init` to build a federation (propose → confirm → create) on a fresh project, or `promote` to adopt an existing single squad (a top-level `team.md`) into a federation as its first sub-squad, relocating its state intact. This is the catch-all federation entry point and runs at the `confirm` tier with gates. Embedded execution (squad-guided / embedded): the server runs this server-side under its gates. Because it is gated, the call returns immediately with a run id and may PAUSE at the Human Gate; poll squad_status with that run id to advance the run after an out-of-band operator approval. Use for cross-sub-squad requests, an explicit sub-squad target, or federation setup.

request.description: The work for the federation this turn (routed to one or more sub-squads).

squad.description: Optional sub-squad name to target directly, overriding meta-routing.

init.description: When true, run Federation Init Mode (propose → confirm → create) on a fresh project, or Federation Expansion Mode (add a new sub-squad and register it) when a federation already exists, before routing.

promote.description: When true on an existing single-squad project (a top-level team.md, no federation.md), run Federation Promotion Mode: adopt the existing squad into a federation as its first sub-squad, relocating its state intact, before routing.

profile.description: Optional profile hint forwarded to a sub-squad's Init when it has no squad yet.

tier.description: Optional model-tier hint forwarded to the selected sub-squad's run.

owner.description: Optional Member Name forwarded to the selected sub-squad's run.

mode.description: Optional autonomy mode. With a single sub-squad target it is forwarded to that sub-squad's run; with mode=autopilot and no squad= target the Federation Coordinator runs the federation-level autopilot meta-pipeline (ordered sub-squad autopilot runs, aggregated federation gates, one consolidated final-outcome validation).

discovery.description: Optional discovery-gate depth, asked once at the federation level and applied per qualifying sub-squad: quick (analyst), standard (designer then analyst), deep (designer, then challenger and experimenter, then analyst), or skip. Each qualifying sub-squad runs its own session and writes its own brief and verdict under its own root. Ignored on an unattended run.

context.description: Optional free-form context to frame the federation turn.

tools.name: squad_status
tools.title: Squad Status
tools.description: Poll an async squad run by its run id and return its status; when the run is complete, return the finished squad-guided artifact. A held run stays paused until an operator approves it out-of-band — the squad never auto-releases a gate.

runId.description: The server-allocated run id returned by squad_run.

tools.name: squad_business_plan
tools.title: Squad Business Plan
tools.description: Turn an idea, opportunity, or rough brief into a sponsor-readable business plan (squad-guided / embedded) in exactly ten sections: Summary, Problem and Customer, Proposed Solution, Value and Success Measures, Scope, Go-to-Market, Cost and Effort Outline, Risks and Dependencies, Milestones, and Open Questions. Plans only: it reaches no tracker and writes to no business system. Served only when the operator has enabled the business tools.

request.description: The opportunity and the sponsor decision.

tools.name: squad_backlog
tools.title: Squad Backlog
tools.description: Turn approved scope into a structured delivery backlog (squad-guided / embedded) returned as JSON: epics, user stories with acceptance criteria, and tasks, plus a flattened 'workItems' array with stable 'ref'/'parentRef' ids. Create the items by calling the Azure DevOps or Jira connector once per element of 'workItems', parents first, linking children by 'parentRef'. This tool only plans — it writes nothing to Azure DevOps or Jira. Served only when the operator has enabled the business tools.

context.description: Approved plan, NFRs, definition of done, exclusions.

tools.name: squad_render_pptx
tools.title: Squad Render PPTX
tools.description: Render a PowerPoint deck from content YAML and style YAML and return a short-lived download link to the generated .pptx file. Deterministic: no model call. Creates a stored file as its only side effect. Served only when the operator has enabled rendering.

contentYaml.description: A YAML document with a top-level 'slides:' array; each item is one slide.

styleYaml.description: The global style.yaml body (dimensions, layouts, defaults).

tools.name: squad_memory_read
tools.title: Squad Memory Read
tools.description: Read one entry of the project's own squad memory and return its content and etag (the etag to pass as expectedEtag on a subsequent write). Deterministic: no model call, no impactful action.

project.description: The project namespace within your tenant (lowercase dns-ish label).

target.description: Optional operator-declared storage destination to use. Omit to use the deployment's default.

tools.name: squad_memory_write
tools.title: Squad Memory Write
tools.description: Write (create or replace) one entry of the project's own squad memory under compare-and-swap and return the new etag. Pass the prior etag as expectedEtag to guard against clobbering a concurrent writer; omit it for a first write. Deterministic: no model call.

project.description: The project namespace within your tenant (lowercase dns-ish label).

content.description: The full new content to persist at 'path'.

expectedEtag.description: The etag from the prior read; the write applies only if it matches.

target.description: Optional operator-declared storage destination to use. Omit to use the deployment's default.

tools.name: squad_memory_sync
tools.title: Squad Memory Sync
tools.description: Flush a batch of the project's own squad-memory entries in one call. Each item is written under its own compare-and-swap; a stale expectedEtag on one item is reported as a conflict in the results without aborting the others. Returns a per-item result array. Deterministic: no model call.

project.description: The project namespace within your tenant (lowercase dns-ish label).

items.description: The entries to flush; each is applied under its own compare-and-swap.

content.description: The full new content for this entry.

expectedEtag.description: The etag from the prior read of this entry.

target.description: Optional operator-declared storage destination to use. Omit to use the deployment's default.

tools.name: squad_history
tools.title: Squad History
tools.description: Browse and open what previous squad runs produced for a project: the squad state, each role's deliverables, and the per-agent history. Use op='index' for a compact picture of what exists, op='list' to enumerate a directory, and op='read' to open one artifact. Deterministic: no model call. Served only when the operator has enabled the squad ledger.

project.description: The project namespace within your tenant (lowercase dns-ish label).

op.description: index (default) summarizes; list enumerates a prefix; read opens one path.

prefix.description: For op='list': a directory such as '.copilot-tracking/plans'.

path.description: For op='read': the artifact path from a list result.
